title: Dimension of the cycle space
statement:
Let $D$ be a digraph with finite vertex set $V$ and finite arc set $A$, given by its tail and head maps, and let $G$ be its underlying simple graph. Then, working over $\bbr$, the dimension of the cycle space $\mathcal{C}$ of $D$ is
\[
\dim_{\bbr}\mathcal{C} = \abs{A} - \abs{V} + \omega,
\]
where $\omega$ is the number of connected components of $G$.
hypotheses_covered: digraph given by tail and head maps
$G$ is the underlying simple graph of the digraph
the cycle space is taken over the reals $\bbr$
